label: Settings of analyse_proceed_stop_v4.py (AUDIT.md 16.19.2): B1, C1, C2 replayed on the step-5 logs, the STOP sessions and the old-pose stand-in for D4. Analysis only: nothing here is a reader value.
declared: 2026-11-17, before any frame was replayed for these candidates (AUDIT.md 16.19.2). The values are those declared there; the palm limit is derived from the true STOPs by the rule there.

S1.what: STOP session S1 (experiments_ab.md section 13 part B), 64 runs, seed 1, 2026-11-15

S2.what: STOP session S2 (experiments_ab.md section 14), 14 runs, seed 3, 2026-11-15

R1.what: R1, the Stage C session (recording plan D1), 20 runs, 2026-11-12

stopped_speed_mps_why: Declared 2026-11-17: the value Nusrat's README uses for 'driving' (speed above 0.05 m/s); stopped = below it in the states read, approach or wait.
dialog_why: The v4 dialog: gesture_hold_s 0.5 (control.json), max_none_gap_s 0.3 (hri_control.json), gesture_window_s 5.0.

b1.why: Declared 2026-11-17: valid arm frames >= max(floor, frac x the frames received for the person in the 2 s window). frac is the existing min_valid_fraction 0.6; floor 10 = 5 Hz; 8 is the declared sensitivity line.

palm_why: Declared 2026-11-17: the limit is the smallest multiple of 5 degrees at or above the 99th percentile of the palm-to-camera angle over all frames of the true STOPs, at most 90.
